title: PluginUpdatedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'plugin.updated'. Loombre Plugin Protocol (LPP) v1, Lane W2 (LD4/LD6/LD1): emitted in the SAME transaction as any NON-EXPANDING manifest re-fetch snapshot update (packages/db/src/query/plugins.ts's updatePluginManifestAndEmit), a non-secret config write (updatePluginConfigAndEmit), a delivery-signing HMAC rotation touch (touchPluginHmacRotatedAndEmit — LD1's 're-mint + return once + plugin.updated event'), a pseudonymization-posture toggle (Lane W5b's setPluginPseudonymizationAndEmit), or an event-grant replacement (Lane W5b's updatePluginEventGrantsAndEmit — replaces admin-plugin-grants.service.ts's earlier documented workaround of reusing updatePluginManifestAndEmit, which could only ever report change='manifest'). ADMIN-ONLY delivery, mirroring settings.updated exactly. `oldValue`/`newValue` NEVER carry the manifest itself, a secret, OR (fix-wave finding H-1) any config VALUE at all: for change='manifest' they are the plugin's own manifest `version` string; for change='config' `oldValue` is always null and `newValue` is the SORTED array of configSchema field NAMES (never values) that changed — a nested `secret: true` marker inside a config value must never be able to ride along into this event, so no config value of any kind is placed here, only which keys differ; for change='hmac-rotated' both are always null (the secret is never placed in an event, oldValue/newValue are only present for this type's schema-shape uniformity with settings.updated); for change='pseudonymization' they are the plugins.pseudonymize_actor_ids boolean before/after; for change='event-grants' they are the plugin's granted event `type` strings before/after, each SORTED ascending (a stable diff-friendly shape, not insertion order).

name.description: The plugin's current name at the time of this update.

change.description: Which facet of the plugin changed.

oldValue.description: The previous value for `change`'s facet, or null (see this schema's top-level description for the shape per `change` value).

newValue.description: The value now in effect for `change`'s facet, or null.

updatedAtMs.description: Epoch ms this row was updated (plugins.updated_at_ms).
